hero.title: Universal Vue Monorepo Website
hero.subtitle: High-performance SSR, SSG, and ISR capabilities sharing core business logic, permissions, and UI components across apps.

ssr.title: Hybrid Rendering
ssr.description: Support for dynamic SSR, build-time SSG prerendering, and ISR stale-while-revalidate caching.

hydration.title: Zero-Waterfall SSR Hydration
hydration.description: TanStack Query prefetching on the server, seamless client dehydration/hydration with no duplicated requests.

permissions.title: Framework-Agnostic Guards
permissions.description: Shared permission engine powering both Nuxt route middleware and Vue Router beforeEach guards.
